title: ServiceCommandRequest
description: Command the UI sends to the service's local message port `ambilight.status`, with `ambilight.ui` as the reply port. A bundle of string key/values. The service replies with ServiceCommandReply.

ServiceCommand.title: ServiceCommand
ServiceCommand.description: `pause`: stop capture (state `paused`) until `resume`. `resume`: restart capture after `pause`. `rediscover`: probe for controllers now.
